title: Eilenberg's inequality for a real function Lipschitz on a set (Federer 2.10.25, upper-integral form)
statement: For every m ∈ ℕ there is a constant C = C(m) ∈ [0, ∞) such that for every P ∈ ℕ, every function f : ℝ^P → ℝ, every L ≥ 0 and every set A ⊆ ℝ^P on which f is L-Lipschitz, there is a Borel function φ : ℝ → [0, ∞] with H^m(A ∩ f⁻¹{t}) ≤ φ(t) for every t ∈ ℝ and ∫_ℝ φ dt ≤ C·L·H^{m+1}(A). Here Hᵏ := μHE[k] is evaluated as an outer measure on arbitrary sets.
lean_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (A : Set (Eucl P)), LipschitzOnWith L f A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ φ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, φ t ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (L : ℝ≥0∞) * (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) A
